Drawing DWG-A-0001 rev A, sheet 1/1: System A – fuel cell system schematic.
Components:
- A-CMP: Electric turbo air compressor
- A-AIR: Air inlet filter
- A-HUM: Membrane humidifier
- A-EXH: Exhaust outlet
- A-H2S: Hydrogen supply
- A-STK: Fuel cell stack
- A-PRG: Anode purge valve
- A-HRB: Hydrogen recirculation blower
- A-CLP: Electric coolant pump
- A-RAD: Radiator
Line list:
- L01 Air from A-AIR (Air inlet filter) to A-CMP (Electric turbo air compressor)
- L02 Air from A-CMP (Electric turbo air compressor) to A-HUM (Membrane humidifier)
- L03 Humidified air from A-HUM (Membrane humidifier) to A-STK (Fuel cell stack)
- L04 Cathode exhaust from A-STK (Fuel cell stack) to A-HUM (Membrane humidifier)
- L05 Cathode exhaust from A-HUM (Membrane humidifier) to A-EXH (Exhaust outlet)
- L06 Hydrogen from A-H2S (Hydrogen supply) to A-STK (Fuel cell stack)
- L07 Anode recirculation from A-STK (Fuel cell stack) to A-HRB (Hydrogen recirculation blower)
- L08 Anode recirculation from A-HRB (Hydrogen recirculation blower) to A-STK (Fuel cell stack)
- L09 Purge gas from A-STK (Fuel cell stack) to A-PRG (Anode purge valve)
- L10 Purge gas from A-PRG (Anode purge valve) to A-EXH (Exhaust outlet)
- L11 Coolant from A-CLP (Electric coolant pump) to A-STK (Fuel cell stack)
- L12 Coolant from A-STK (Fuel cell stack) to A-RAD (Radiator)
- L13 Coolant from A-RAD (Radiator) to A-CLP (Electric coolant pump)
Notes: Schematic, not to scale. Sensors and check valves are not shown.
